name: Fur-Bearing Trout
description: The fur-bearing trout is a legendary fish, North American and Icelandic in origin, said to grow a thick coat of fur to survive cold northern waters; in practice it is a long-running tall tale and taxidermy hoax in which a real trout is mounted with rabbit fur attached.
origin: The fur-bearing trout is a folkloric and tourist tradition of North America (especially the northern Rockies, the Great Lakes region, and Canada) and a folktale tradition of Iceland. There is no real biological range.
